title: An Extension of Major-Minor Mean Field Game Theory
summary: This work extends the theory presented in Mean Field Games with a Dominating Player by Bensoussan, Chau and Yam on mean field games with a dominating player, to the case in which the utility and cost functions depend not only on the law of the states, but on the joint state--control law. We incorporate the conditional distribution of the state--control pair of the representative agent given the common noise of the dominating player. In addition, we generalize the role of the dominating player to include the direct impact of its controls $u_0$ on the dynamics and functionals of the system.…
